open_points.subject: Customer erased mark
open_points.text: records the erased mark with its own instant
open_points.question: Is the erased state represented by one nullable instant that is itself the mark, by a separate mark/status plus an instant, or by a distinct value model; and what identity, if any, does that value model have?
options: A nullable erased-at instant on Customer is both the mark and its time
A separate erased boolean or status and erased-at instant on Customer
A nested value model containing the mark and instant
open_points.default_guess: Use one nullable erased-at instant on Customer as both the mark and its time.

witness.initial: A non-erased Customer exists with revision 2 and created and last-changed instants.
events: The owner erases the Customer's contact data.
State 1 is handed to later model-closure and contract agents.
outcomes: One agent defines a nullable erased-at field whose presence is the erased mark.
Another defines an erased status or boolean plus a separate erased-at field, or introduces a nested ErasureMark value model.
witness.observer: Generated-model and contract consumers see different model facts and possibly a different model identity.

open_points.subject: read a customer and list customers
open_points.text: records the erased mark with its own instant
open_points.question: Which product action, if any, reads and returns the erased mark's instant?
options: The instant is retained internally but no product read returns it
Read a customer returns it for an erased Customer
Read and list customers return it for an erased Customer
open_points.default_guess: Retain it internally and omit it from reads because the stated read outputs promise only that the Customer is erased.

witness.initial: A Customer exists and has not been erased.
events: The owner erases the Customer's contact data at an identifiable instant.
The owner later reads that Customer or lists customers.
outcomes: The answer reports only that the Customer is erased.
The answer also reports the instant of erasure.
witness.observer: The owner sees different facts in the product response.

open_points.subject: Customer erasure fields
open_points.text:
An erasure does not move it: it removes the revision and the
  last-changed instant with every other fact but the identity, and records
  the erased mark with its own instant (M04, A04 rule 1; owner, 2026-11-24).
open_points.question: Replace this prose-only addition with an explicit declaration of every retained erasure field and its type, including whether the mark and its instant are one field or separate fields.
